description: This source file defines the CreateBsonPredicateVisitor class, which implements a singleton visitor pattern to convert Predicate objects into BSON filters for MongoDB queries. It provides methods to generate various BSON filter criteria such as equality, greater than, less than, in list, regex like, etc., specific to predicates used in querying within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: CreateBsonPredicateVisitor
classes.description: A singleton class implementing PredicateVisitor to convert Predicate objects into BSON filters for MongoDB queries, supporting various predicate types including equality, range comparisons, list inclusion, and pattern matching.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CreateBsonPredicateVisitor.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method that creates a BSON filter from a given predicate and field name.

methods.name: visitEq
methods.description: Generates a BSON filter for equality comparison.

methods.name: visitGe
methods.description: Generates a BSON filter for greater-than-or-equal comparison.

methods.name: visitGt
methods.description: Generates a BSON filter for greater-than comparison.

methods.name: visitIn
methods.description: Generates a BSON filter for inclusion in a list.

methods.name: visitLe
methods.description: Generates a BSON filter for less-than-or-equal comparison.

methods.name: visitLike
methods.description: Generates a BSON regex filter after removing leading/trailing wildcards for pattern matching.

methods.name: removeLeadingOrTrailingWildcard
methods.description: Helper method to strip leading '^\Q\E.*' and trailing '.*\Q\E$' wildcards from the pattern string to optimize query performance.

methods.name: visitLt
methods.description: Generates a BSON filter for less-than comparison.

methods.name: visitNe
methods.description: Generates a BSON filter for not-equal comparison.
